keyEvents.text: Goal! AC Milan 1, Inter Milan 0. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Diego Moreira with a cross.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Inter Milan 0. Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Diego Moreira following a corner.
Goal! AC Milan 2, Inter Milan 1. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter Milan) header from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1. Diego Moreira (AC Milan) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
First Half ends, AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1.
Second Half begins AC Milan 3, Inter Milan 1.
Koni De Winter (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Diego Moreira (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card.
